description: Epicenter Settings (the `home` window). It administers this app's active local transcription model through the transcription plugin: which model is active, downloading model files, removing them, and showing their folders, and the unload policy (ADR-0180); model identity is administration data, so `get_active_model` is granted here and nowhere else. It signs the app in and out as `so.epicenter` and shows who it is signed in as: the shell's sign-in holds the token (`epicenter-account`), and the page reads `account.json` from the app's data through the folder plugin. It turns starting at login on and off (ADR-0819). Its page is served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561).
